maddeler.e:
ننحرق (form VII)
# نَنْحَرِقُ (nanḥariqu) /nan.ħa.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# نَنْحَرِقَ (nanḥariqa) /nan.ħa.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
# نَنْحَرِقْ (nanḥariq) /nan.ħa.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَرَقَ (inḥaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
